description: This file defines the interface BaseUnivariateSolver for univariate rootfinding algorithms in the Apache Commons Math library. It includes method signatures for configuring and executing root searches, as well as accessing solver properties.

classes.name: BaseUnivariateSolver
classes.description: A generic interface for univariate real rootfinding algorithms, providing methods for solving equations and retrieving solver configurations.

methods.name: getMaxEvaluations
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of function evaluations allowed.

methods.name: getEvaluations
methods.description: Returns the number of evaluations performed in the last solve.

methods.name: getAbsoluteAccuracy
methods.description: Returns the absolute accuracy target for solutions.

methods.name: getRelativeAccuracy
methods.description: Returns the relative accuracy target for solutions.

methods.name: getFunctionValueAccuracy
methods.description: Returns the function value accuracy target.

methods.name: solve
methods.description: Overloaded methods to find a root within specified bounds or vicinity, with configurable maximum evaluations.
